title: SEBI Clears Standing Instructions for SWP and STP in Demat-Held Mutual Funds
summary: Allows demat unit holders to execute automatic Systematic Withdrawal and Transfer Plans.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Clears Standing Instructions for SWP and STP in Demat-Held Mutual Funds. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Allows demat unit holders to execute automatic Systematic Withdrawal and Transfer Plans.
2-Phase Rollout: Unit-based SWPs/STPs by Jan 31, 2027; Amount-based by April 30, 2027.
Nodal Facilitator: Depositories designated as nodal facilitators (operational framework by Oct 31, 2026).
Unit-based SWP deadline (Jan 31, 2027) vs Amount-based SWP deadline (April 30, 2027).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
